summary: Abimelech cuts a tree on Mount Zalmon during the fighting at Shechem. Psalm 68 pictures snow on Zalmon when the Almighty scatters kings.

senses.definition: Judges identifies Zalmon as a mountain reached from Shechem. The psalm names Zalmon without locating it.

note: The psalm does not establish that its Zalmon is the same mountain as in Judges, or explain its name. Retain the full consonants. צֶלֶם “image” is under tselem. A warrior in David’s retinue bears the same name.
